faqs.question: How do I pitch a startup story or funding announcement?
faqs.answer: Send your pitch deck or press release to editorial@goreadpost.com with embargo details if applicable.

faqs.question: What is your editorial policy regarding sponsored coverage?
faqs.answer: GoReadPost maintains complete separation between editorial reporting and brand sponsorships. Editorial stories cannot be purchased.

faqs.question: How can I advertise or sponsor a newsletter dispatch?
